A massive female '''fyrnock''' lived on the [[planetoid]] [[PM-1203]] located in the [[Anaxes asteroid belt]] as the leader of her pack. In the year [[Standard year|4 BBY]], [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Ezra Bridger]] used the [[dark side of the Force]] to summon her in order to protect himself and his Master, [[Kanan Jarrus]], against the [[the Grand Inquisitor]].<ref name="GF" />
